cards.card_text: They gather the grapes, tread them, hold a festival and go into the house of their god.
cards.verse_text: And after they had gone out into the fields, gathered grapes from their vineyards, and trodden them, they held a festival and went into the house of their god; and as they ate and drank, they cursed Abimelech.

cards.card_text: Then it says, "Year upon year let your festivals recur."
cards.verse_text: Year upon year let your festivals recur.
cards.snippet: Year upon year let your festivals recur.

cards.card_text: Sing as on a holy festival night Hide away in the hills Run back down to Egypt
cards.verse_text: You will sing as on the night of a holy festival, and your heart will rejoice like one who walks to the music of a flute, going up to the mountain of the LORD, to the Rock of Israel.

cards.card_text: At the festivals and appointed feasts, the grain and oil offerings follow the same pattern as the New Moon.
cards.verse_text: At the festivals and appointed feasts, the grain offering shall be an ephah with a bull, an ephah with a ram, and as much as one is able to give with the lambs, along with a hin of oil per ephah.
